explanation: The first token of the head noun or name that follows a quantifier or determiner ('how many OSC|ars', 'these Toyota Si|enna', 'two Tre|os', 'three U.S.', 'how many such paralle|lograms', 'some Anna Nicole', 'All Kle|pper'), usually a rare multi-token word; 'with broken hips' / 'other big guys' are looser cases.
